prompts.L1:
Please polish the following text to make it more eloquent and professional, keeping all original information unchanged:

A hand dryer device includes nozzles to blow airflows into a hand-placeable drying portion, a blower to generate the airflow to be blown out of the nozzles, a sensor having a light-emitting element to detect the presence or absence of a hand in the drying portion, and a controller to make a hand detection determination of whether the hand is present or absent in the drying portion based on a detection result of the sensor, and control driving of the blower based on a determination result of the hand detection determination. The controller controls an intermittent driving of the light-emitting element of the sensor. In first and second driving cycles of the sensor, when a determination result in the first driving cycle and a first determination result in the second driving cycle differ from each other, the controller extends a driving period of the sensor in the second driving cycle.

The hand dryer includes a drying portion into which a user places their hands. Nozzles direct airflow into this drying portion, while a blower generates the airflow discharged through the nozzles.

A sensor equipped with a light-emitting element detects whether a hand is present in the drying portion. Based on the sensor’s hand-presence determination, a controller operates the blower to initiate or stop the drying airflow. The controller also intermittently drives the sensor’s light-emitting element in successive sensor-driving cycles.

If the hand-detection result obtained during a second sensor-driving cycle differs from the result obtained during a first sensor-driving cycle, the controller extends the sensor-driving period in the second cycle. This extended driving period allows the controller to verify the change in detection status more reliably before controlling the blower.
outputs.L4:
A hand dryer includes a housing having one or more airflow nozzles, a blower configured to discharge air through the nozzles, an optical sensor for detecting a user’s hands, and a controller that controls operation of the blower in response to the sensor output. To reduce power consumption and limit unnecessary sensor operation, the controller drives the optical sensor intermittently in successive sensing cycles. During each cycle, the sensor operates for a predetermined sensing period, and the controller determines whether hands are present based on the resulting detection signal.

The controller compares the determination made in a current sensing cycle with the determination made in the preceding cycle. If the two determinations are the same, the controller may continue using the normal sensing period. If they differ—for example, when the sensor changes from “no hands detected” to “hands detected,” or vice versa—the controller extends the sensing period of the second cycle. The extended period allows additional sensor data to be collected before the controller confirms the change in detection state.

Once the presence of hands is confirmed, the controller activates the blower so that drying air is discharged through the airflow nozzles. When removal of the hands is confirmed, the controller stops the blower. By temporarily extending sensing only when consecutive determinations disagree, the dryer can reject momentary noise, reflections, or brief movements while retaining rapid response and low standby power consumption. This improves the reliability of hand detection and helps prevent both unintended blower operation and premature shutdown during use.

## The Power of “The”

“The” may be a small word, but it plays an essential role in the English language. Known as the definite article, it points to a specific person, place, object, or idea. For example, “a book” can refer to any book, while “the book” identifies one that is already known or understood.

This simple word helps create clarity and shared meaning. It appears in everyday expressions such as “the sun,” “the future,” and “the truth.” In each case, “the” directs attention toward something particular or unique.

Although it is one of the most frequently used words in English, “the” often goes unnoticed. Its quiet presence connects ideas, adds precision, and makes communication more effective. It shows that even the smallest words can have a significant impact.

counterfactuals.prompt: Write a patent-style abstract for a hand dryer that uses an intermittently driven optical sensor and extends the sensor’s active period when consecutive hand-detection results differ.
counterfactuals.output: A hand dryer includes an air outlet, a blower configured to discharge air through the air outlet, an optical sensor configured to detect a user’s hands, and a controller. The controller intermittently drives the optical sensor according to alternating active and inactive periods and controls the blower based on detection results obtained from the optical sensor. The controller compares consecutive hand-detection results and, when the consecutive results differ, extends a current active period or initiates an additional active period to obtain one or more further detection results. The extended sensing period reduces erroneous switching caused by transient or ambiguous detections while permitting intermittent sensor operation to reduce power consumption.

counterfactuals.prompt: Summarize an invention that improves hand detection reliability in a hand dryer by intermittently operating the sensor’s light-emitting element and extending its driving time after conflicting determinations.
counterfactuals.output: The invention improves automatic hand detection in a hand dryer by normally pulsing an optical sensor’s light-emitting element for short periods to conserve power and limit interference. When successive sensor readings conflict—such as alternating between detecting and not detecting hands—the controller temporarily extends the light-emission driving time. This produces a stronger, more reliable reflected-light signal, allowing the dryer to determine hand presence accurately and avoid false activation or premature stopping.
